images.rotation_evidence: shown as the record has it. The scan direction is fixed for the whole record, so a 180 degree turn makes an image paint against every other image -- image 2 was the only 180 and the only one that played right to left. The book plate disagrees; the record is authoritative, so the plate was rotated to match (docs/reference/crops/2.jpg).
